bounds: One service and task row. Three calls represent a daemon preflight, explicit execution read, and resume read. One-shot and repeat cases separate exclusive claims from nonblocking overlap. Storage and worker stages may fail or preserve the row. Stop can interleave with every pending stage.

assumptions: No fairness assumption. Closing the service prevents new execution receipts.
No fairness assumption. Preflight, initial read and one-shot recheck must observe a closed service before entering the worker.
No fairness assumption. An exclusive claim must observe every outstanding invocation, including nonblocking calls.

Weak fairness of each call's completion actions and the drain action. Every admitted storage, preflight and worker operation eventually returns or throws. A worker does not await its own service stop.
